# PROSTHETIC VALVE ENDOCARDITIS WITH STAPHYLOCOCCI

Endocarditis with Staphylococcus aureus and coagulase-negative staphylococci are

treated similarly. Surgery is required frequently in these patients.

# Treatment for methicillin-susceptible strains

[Nafcillin 2 gm IV q4h \($$\) DI x 6 weeks <AND> rifampin 300 mg PO/NG q8h](orz-set-abx-nafcil-2gm-iv-q4h-rifamp-300mg-q8h-gent-1mg-kg-q8h)

($) [DI,O] for 6 weeks <AND> gentamicin 1 mg/kg IV q8h ($) [R,O] for initial 2

weeks

# Treatment for methicillin-resistant strains

[Vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h \($\) R x 6 weeks <AND> rifampin 300 mg PO/NG](orz-set-abx-vanco-15mg-kg-iv-q12h-rifamp-300mg-po-gent-1mg-kg)

($) [DI,O] q8h for 6 weeks <AND> gentamicin 1 mg/kg IV q8h ($) [R,O] for initial

2 weeks
